data.name: Ice Queen CEO's Fierce Possession
data.detailed_description:
Ice Queen CEO's Fierce Possession - An Immersive Visual Interactive Novel.
Core Plot Introduction: Programmer Brooks gets trapped in a time loop after experiencing multiple deaths on July 15, 2024. Every time he wakes up, it's 7:15 on the same day, and he witnesses CEO Victoria die in an explosion at a press conference. To change fate, he confesses the truth of the loop to Victoria, which triggers a series of thrilling stories. He also meets agent Nina in the loop, and the relationship among the three is intricate, with a company's 'luck manipulation' experimental conspiracy hidden behind.
Worldview Atmosphere: The story is set in a future world full of a sense of technology. The headquarters building of Aether Dynamics shows an advanced technological atmosphere. The town of Edenville seems peaceful on the surface, but in fact, it's involved in a dangerous experiment. The whole town becomes an experimental field, full of unknown dangers and a mysterious atmosphere.
Highlights of Female Character Interactions: The ice - cold CEO Victoria has a strong aura. Her attitude towards Brooks changes from suspicion to gradual trust, and the interaction between them is full of passion and tension. Agent Nina is cold and decisive. Her encounter with Brooks is full of conflicts and desires, and her complex relationship with Victoria also adds more highlights to the story.
Tension in Character Relationships: The relationships among Brooks, Victoria, and Nina are complex and changeable. Brooks tries hard to save them. Victoria and Nina are not only in a hostile relationship but also have a subtle connection because of Brooks. Their emotional entanglements and conflicts of interest make the story full of tension.
Scene Features: From the press - conference hall at the Aether Dynamics headquarters, to the abandoned toll booth on Highway 17, and then to the interior of the black Rolls - Royce S900, each scene has a unique atmosphere. The explosion scene in the press - conference hall is exciting, the confrontation in the rain at the highway toll booth is full of danger, and the passionate interaction in the car adds an emotional touch to the story.
Immersive Experience: Players will follow Brooks' perspective and personally experience the wonder and horror of the time loop. In repeated deaths and rebirths, they can experience thrilling adventures and feel the emotional entanglements among the characters, as if they are in the story.
High - definition Visual Performance: The game uses high - definition graphics to vividly show the characters' expressions, movements, and scene details. Whether it's the crystal chandelier in the press - conference hall or the mech exoskeleton in the rain, players can feel realistic visual effects.
Functional Gameplay Features: It supports offline play, allowing players to immerse themselves in the story anytime and anywhere. The one - key backtracking function makes it convenient for players to review important plots. The auto - play function allows players to experience the story more easily. The chapter - browsing function enables players to freely choose the chapters they want to read. High - definition CGs bring a more beautiful visual experience to players, and the smooth reading experience allows players to immerse themselves and feel the charm of the story.

data.short_description: Programmer Brooks gets trapped in a time loop and witnesses the death of CEO Victoria multiple times. He tries to change fate and gets entangled with Victoria and agent Nina in the loop, uncovering the company's experimental conspiracy.
